crossRefs.note: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there…
For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are…
But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.
For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be…
But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the…
Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?
I know, and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers…
But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.

translations.web: However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of the idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.
translations.bsb: But not everyone has this knowledge. Some people are still so accustomed to idols that they eat such food as if it were sacrificed to an idol. And since their conscience is weak, it is defiled.
translations.kjv: Howbeit there is not in every man that knowledge: for some with conscience of the idol unto this hour eat it as a thing offered unto an idol; and their conscience being weak is defiled.
translations.asv: Howbeit there is not in all men that knowledge: but some, being used until now to the idol, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol; and their conscience being weak is defiled.
